description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It includes methods for setting keys, resetting, and computing HMAC results, and defines specific typedefs for common hash algorithms.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: A template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key setup, input, reset, and result retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the key for HMAC, hashing it if necessary, and prepares inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm state and initializes it with the inner pad.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC result, performing final hashing if not already computed.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash algorithm for HMAC computation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input data into the HMAC object.
